snippet.title: Seaworks - Trap Season | Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Something new is on the horizon⚓ 🦀
We’re excited to share that we’re working on Seaworks: Trap Season, a crab fishing life sim set in the remote Pacific Northwest of the 1990s.
Build your life around your boat, your cabin, and the sea.
Take on fishing jobs, set your traps, manage your equipment, and face the challenges of unpredictable waters.
From changing weather to boat maintenance and the daily grind of island life, every trip tells a new story.

Add to your wishlist now: https://seaworks.aerosoft.com

#fishingsimulationgame #fishinggame #simulator #simulation #simulationgames
